features.name: Weapon consists of form-memory steel alloy; completely drawn weapon stiffens into a double-edged combat blade.
It remains flexible while partly covered by its special sheath.
Sheath may be integrated into a belt or sewn into clothing; a standard Swiss-army folding knife would be the wrong representation.
Use the fully drawn rigid state for a standalone weapon reference and identify sheath/belt separately if depicted.
